item.title: Delaware murder suspect tried to escape by climbing into ceiling of interview room: state police
item.description: A Delaware murder suspect who was arrested after more than a year on the run is accused of trying to escape custody by climbing through the ceiling of a state police interview room.

item.title: Philadelphia Mayor Parker proposes $1 rideshare tax to fund public schools, prevent staff cuts
item.description: Mayor Cherelle Parker has proposed increasing Philadelphia's rideshare tax to $1 per trip to generate recurring local funding for the School District of Philadelphia, aiming to protect recent educational progress and prevent staff cuts.

item.title: Camden County park shooting: Families seek justice nearly 7 years after teens killed on Easter Sunday
item.description: Families continue to seek justice nearly seven years after two teenagers were killed and a third was injured in a 2019 Camden County park shooting, as investigators pursue new leads and re-test evidence.

item.title: TSA shortages prompt ICE deployment at Philadelphia International and 12 other airports: reports
item.description: Philadelphia International Airport is reportedly among several major airports where ICE agents are being deployed to help with long lines. Here's what we know.

item.title: Kermit Gosnell, convicted in Philadelphia abortion and pill mill cases, dies
item.description: Dr. Kermit Gosnell, a Philadelphia abortion doctor convicted of murder and drug offenses, has died.

item.title: Mayfair dog missing for 11 years reunited with owner thanks to microchip
item.description: A pitbull named Forty Cal was reunited with his owner, Jourdyn Koviak, 11 years after going missing from Mayfair, thanks to an updated microchip and ACCT Philly.

item.title: Bucks County mom charged with child abuse after Walmart incident in Tullytown
item.description: A Bucks County mother has been arrested and charged with child abuse and aggravated assault after allegedly abusing her young child at a local Walmart.

item.title: NJ home intruder caught trying to sexually assault sleeping victim subdued by residents: police
item.description: An alleged sexual assault attempt was thwarted by fast-acting residents after authorities say a man crawled through the window of a New Jersey home and into the bed of a sleeping victim.

item.title: Philadelphia International Airport attempting record for 'Longest Line of Cheesesteaks'
item.description: Philadelphia International Airport's PHL Food & Shops is attempting to set a Guinness World Record for the "Longest Line of Cheesesteaks" on Tuesday, which is National Cheesesteak Day.
